entities.summary: Joshua A. Fogel is an American-Canadian Sinologist, historian, and translator who specializes in the history of modern China, especially focusing on the cultural and political relations between China and Japan. Before retiring and becoming professor emeritus in 2024, he held a Tier 1 Canada Research Chair at York University in Toronto from 2005. Before that he taught at Harvard University (1981–1988) and the University of California, Santa Barbara (1989–2005). He is a fellow of the Royal Society of Canada. Fogel was a journalists & chroniclers from Brooklyn (b. 1950-05-23, Brooklyn). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
